**Wire verb `readers read-matches`**: Read identifications through the cross-format spectral\_match view - scan, sequences, accession, decoy flag, modifications and the q-value, rank and threshold a format records - optionally with each engine's scores as long rows.

# Wraps

- [`ISpectralMatch`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/BaseClasses/ISpectralMatch.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/BaseClasses/ISpectralMatch.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`MzIdentMLResultFile.SkippedMatches`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/ExternalResults/ResultFiles/MzIdentMLResultFile.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/ExternalResults/ResultFiles/MzIdentMLResultFile.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`
- [`MzIdentMLRecord.Scores`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/23c2490e/mzLib/Readers/ExternalResults/IndividualResultRecords/MzIdentMLRecord.cs) in `mzLib/Readers/ExternalResults/IndividualResultRecords/MzIdentMLRecord.cs` at mzLib `23c2490e`

# Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` (wire `--path`) | `path` | required | — | — | An MsPathFinderT \_IcTarget/\_IcDecoy/\_IcTda.tsv, a Casanovo .mztab, or an mzIdentML .mzid / .mzid.gz. |
| `offset` (wire `--offset`) | `int` | `0` | matches | `>= 0` | Skip this many matches. A window, not a cursor: mzLib parses the whole file on every call, so paging re-reads it. |
| `limit` (wire `--limit`) | `int` | absent | matches | `>= 0` | Return at most this many matches. Absent means no limit; there is deliberately no default cap. |
| `scores` (wire `--scores`) | `flag` | `false` | — | — | Make the table long by score: one row per match and engine score, adding match\_index, score\_name and score\_value. Only mzIdentML records scores (\#1306); other formats keep one row per match with the two columns in absent\_fields. offset and limit still count matches. |
| `out` (wire `--out`) | `path` | absent | — | — | Write the table to this path as tab-separated text instead of returning columns. Must differ from path. Parent directories are created. |

# Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path of the input. |
| `file_type` | `string` | — | never | The mzLib SupportedFileType that was dispatched. |
| `reader` | `string` | — | never | The mzLib reader class that parsed the file. |
| `skipped_count` | `int` | items | yes: the format keeps no skip list (every format but mzIdentML) | mzIdentML items mzLib did not represent (crosslinks, unresolvable modifications, substitutions); record\_count + skipped\_count is the items in the file (\#1313). |
| `skipped` | `object[]` | — | yes: as skipped\_count | {spectrum\_identification\_item\_id, spectrum\_id, reason} per skipped item. |
| `record_count` | `int` | matches | never | Matches in the whole file, before the window. |
| `rows_not_read` | `int` | rows | yes: never counted for this view | Data rows that did not become records. |
| `retention_time_unit` | `string` | — | yes: the view has no time column | Always null for this view. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | What this view cannot be trusted to mean for THIS file, each citing the mzLib source. |
| `columns` (wire `column_names`) | `string[]` | — | never | Column order. |
| `absent_fields` | `string[]` | — | never | Columns the view defines that this file's format has no column or source for; null in every row (BULK.md section 4). Empty when every column has a source. |
| `failed_fields` | `string[]` | — | never | 'field: ExceptionType' for each column whose read threw on some returned rows; those cells are null. |
| `excluded_fields` | `object[]` | — | never | {field, type, reason, verb} for each field with no column shape; verb names the command that carries it, or null. |
| wire `error` | `object` | — | yes: always, for a single path: a file that cannot be read fails the call instead | {kind, type, message}; non-null only in a files\[\] entry under on-error skip. |
| `scores_included` | `bool` | — | never | Whether --scores made the table long by score. |
| `returned_count` | `int` | matches | never | Matches returned in columns (the unit offset and limit count in); 0 when written to out. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Rows in columns: more than returned\_count in a long table, where one record gives several rows; 0 when written to out. |
| `offset` | `int` | matches | never | The offset applied, in matches. |
| `truncated` | `bool` | — | never | True whenever records were left out by offset or limit. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | yes: the table was written to out instead | Column name to per-row values, in column\_names order. |
| `output` | `object` | — | yes: out was not given | {path, format: "tsv", row\_count} when out was given. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source_index` | `int` | — | never | 0-based position of the row's input in the stdin list. *Present only with `--paths-stdin`.* |
| `source_path` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path of the row's input. *Present only with `--paths-stdin`.* |
| `file_name_without_extension` | `string` | — | never | The spectra file of the match. |
| `one_based_scan_number` | `int` | — | never | Scan number; see caveats for mzIdentML index= and Casanovo. |
| `base_sequence` | `string` | — | never | Unmodified sequence. |
| `full_sequence` | `string` | — | never | Modified sequence. |
| `accession` | `string` | — | yes: the property threw (then in failed\_fields) | Protein accession(s). |
| `is_decoy` | `bool` | — | yes: every format but MsPathFinderT (then in absent\_fields) | Decoy flag. |
| `modifications` | `string` | — | never | 'position:name' pairs, ';'-joined, 1 = N-terminus. |
| `modification_count` | `int` | — | never | Modifications on the match. |
| `q_value` | `float` | fraction (0 to 1) | yes: the format has no q-value (in absent\_fields) or this mzIdentML item reports none | PSM-level q-value (mzIdentML MS:1002354 or a child; MsPathFinderT QValue). |
| `rank` | `int` | — | yes: not mzIdentML (in absent\_fields) | The item's rank; filter on rank == 1. |
| `pass_threshold` | `bool` | — | yes: not mzIdentML (in absent\_fields) | The item's passThreshold. |
| `match_index` | `int` | — | never | 0-based position of the match among the file's matches. *Present only with `scores`.* |
| `score_name` | `string` | — | yes: the match has no scores, or the format records none (in absent\_fields) | Engine score name as written, e.g. MS-GF:SpecEValue. *Present only with `scores`.* |
| `score_value` | `float` | engine-defined (see score\_name) | yes: as score\_name | The score's value. *Present only with `scores`.* |

# Errors

| Kind | mzLibRust returns | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | path missing or blank; file or directory not found; mzLib does not recognise the file type (the message points at readers formats) |
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | offset, limit or out given with no value; offset or limit &lt; 0; non-integer value; out resolves to the same file as path |
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | the file has no spectral\_match view |
| `correctness` | [`MzLibError::Bridge`](crate::MzLibError::Bridge) | mzLib recognises the file and fails to parse it |
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | paths-stdin with path, offset or limit; paths-stdin with a value; no paths on stdin; a repeated path; threads 0 or below -1; on-error not fail or skip; on-error skip with a single path; out naming an input |
| `usage` | [`MzLibError::Usage`](crate::MzLibError::Usage) | with on-error fail, an input that is missing or not this view: the usage error of that input, prefixed 'Input &lt;i&gt; (&lt;path&gt;)' |
| `correctness` | [`MzLibError::Bridge`](crate::MzLibError::Bridge) | with on-error fail, mzLib failing to parse an input: that input's own error type, message prefixed 'Input &lt;i&gt; (&lt;path&gt;)' |
| `service_unavailable` | [`MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable`](crate::MzLibError::ServiceUnavailable) | never returned by this verb |

Any call can also fail on the way to mzLib or back, whatever the verb: [`MzLibError::BridgeNotFound`](crate::MzLibError::BridgeNotFound), [`MzLibError::Timeout`](crate::MzLibError::Timeout), [`MzLibError::Protocol`](crate::MzLibError::Protocol) or [`MzLibError::Io`](crate::MzLibError::Io).

# Caveats

- Nothing is FDR-filtered. q\_value is filled only by mzIdentML and an MsPathFinderT file with a QValue column; an \_IcTarget/\_IcDecoy file has none and names it absent (mzLib would report 0).
- mzIdentML: every SpectrumIdentificationItem is a row, lower ranks and failed thresholds included (MzIdentMLResultFile.cs:177). Filter on rank == 1 and pass\_threshold.
- mzIdentML: is\_decoy is absent because the isDecoy attribute defaults to false when omitted (MzIdentMLResultFile.cs:173).
- mzIdentML: items mzLib cannot represent are skipped, not failed, and listed in skipped (MzIdentMLResultFile.cs:123).
- MsPathFinderT: is\_decoy comes from an XXX protein-name prefix (MsPathFinderTResult.cs:92); accession assumes a UniProt header and lands in failed\_fields otherwise.
- Casanovo: one\_based\_scan\_number is the mzTab index plus one (CasanovoMzTabFile.cs:116).
- Many files: --paths-stdin reads the list in ONE process, --threads at a time, into one long table with source\_index and source\_path first. The output does not depend on --threads (a tested property); the default of 1 is a memory choice, since every reader materialises the whole file.
